//: With verbatimModuleSyntax: true, `import type { X }` is erased entirely. NestJS uses the
class itself as the DI token, emitted by emitDecoratorMetadata into design:paramtypes.
The moment a lint autofix (consistent-type-imports) rewrites an injectable's import to
`import type`, the runtime value disappears: typecheck passes, lint passes, and the API
dies on boot with 'Nest can't resolve dependencies of ...'.
This is why the override lives in the shared preset rather than in each app: an app-level
override is one careless copy-paste away from being dropped.
Proven at PH-0.3 by a two-service DI probe compiled and executed before the health endpoint.
